source_observation.evidence_section: Methods / Computational screening for T. pallidum DNA
source_observation.use_summary: Used MALT within eager/HOPS for ancient-pathogen screening against a stated 2017 database. Separately built a 91-spirochete custom index and screened 36214 sequencing datasets with MALT 0.5.2, BlastN/SemiGlobal, identity 90%, up to 25 alignments per query and 100000 per reference, followed by target extraction and a separate bacterial rescreen.
source_observation.evidence_locator: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11964931/ (section: Methods / Computational screening for T. pallidum DNA)
source_observation.implementation_scope_note: The main article does not report the eager-screening MALT version. The 0.4.1 development adapter is a software control, not proof of the authors environment or the separate 0.5.2 role. The supplement reports 0.5.2 followed by superscript citation 61, not 0.5.261. Custom reference dates, accession mapping, aligned-read output and 130G/16-worker execution remain separate requirements; current small controls do not reproduce the historical analysis.

current_scope: Owned complete DNA FASTA/index-build to original MALT0.5.2 BlastN workflow with explicit native-accession-alternative mapping. Retains unclassified original and separately mapped indexes; captures every reference, mapping and query, enforces identical complete index handoff and checks original SAM/RMA/aligned FASTA geometry and naive/readCount classification. Explicit CUSTOM052/ STANDALONE profiles and original resource/process receipts. CUSTOM052 represents the supplement-reported SemiGlobal/90%/25-alignments/100000-per-reference screen; the main pipeline version is unreported. Read MALT052_INTEGRATION.md. Historical database/query reproduction, original0.5.2 accession-map path, full MALT/HOPS/nf-core equivalence and biological authentication remain separate.
